tools.name: fahce_diagnose_integrity
tools.description: Discover evidence-based claim diagnosis via x402 POST /api/v1/diagnose. Returns findings and a receipt. Example: claimed success versus a failure log.

tools.name: fahce_plan_bounded_repair
tools.description: Discover correction planning via x402 POST /api/v1/repair. Returns an evidence-preserving proposal and receipt. Example: correct a contradicted success claim.

tools.name: fahce_verify_repaired_output
tools.description: Discover submitted-answer verification via x402 POST /api/v1/verify. Returns evidence-bounded findings and a receipt. Example: check a revised deployment status.

tools.name: fahce_integrity_repair_bundle
tools.description: Discover combined diagnosis, proposed correction, and verification via x402 POST /api/v1/repair-bundle. Example: resolve a disputed completion claim. No repair executes.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: fahce_verify_repaired_output · Public sink: fahce_diagnose_integrity, fahce_plan_bounded_repair, fahce_verify_repaired_output, fahce_integrity_repair_bundle.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: fahce_verify_repaired_output · Public sink: fahce_diagnose_integrity, fahce_plan_bounded_repair, fahce_verify_repaired_output, fahce_integrity_repair_bundle

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
